operations.summary: Query ad-hoc YouTube Analytics metrics and dimensions.
operations.description: Official youtubeAnalytics.reports.query (GET /v2/reports). Kept blocked because the connector direct-read executor cannot yet provide a bounded, typed provider-query surface across the separate Analytics API host without broad raw-query escape hatches.
operations.approval: blocked by default; no live provider call is made by this connector operation definition

operations.summary: Download generated YouTube Reporting report bytes.
operations.description: Official youtubereporting.media.download (GET /v1/media/{+resourceName}?alt=media). Kept blocked because generated report payloads are CSV/GZIP/binary bytes and the connector runtime intentionally lacks a bounded binary file-download executor for this surface.
operations.approval: blocked by default pending bounded destination-file policy, size limits, digest/audit evidence, and explicit operator approval
